## One Critical Item to Fix

### ⚠️ PHP Version Specification Mismatch

**Issue:** Plan requires PHP 8.0+, but code uses readonly properties (PHP 8.1+ only)

**Fix:** Update `composer.json` to require PHP 8.1:
```json
{
  "require": {
    "php": ">=8.1",
    "wordpress/abilities-api": "^1.0"
  }
}
```

**Impact:** Without this fix, readonly properties will cause parse errors on PHP 8.0
